identificationModule.briefTitle: A Trial to Assess Efficacy, Safety, Pharmacokinetics of Octreotide Subcutaneous Injection in Patients With Gastroentero-pancreatic Neuroendocrine Tumor (GEP-NET)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase Ⅱ Randomized, Parallel-group, Open-label, Active-controlled Trial to Assess the Efficacy, Safety and Pharmacokinetics of the Long-acting Octreotide Subcutaneous Injection (SYHX2008) Versus Octreotide Microspheres (Sandostatin LAR@) in Patients With GEP-NET

leadSponsor.name: CSPC ZhongQi Pharmaceutical Technology Co., Ltd.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to compare the effectiveness, safety, pharmacokinetics (PK) of SYHX2008 vs Octreotide Microspheres (Sandostatin LAR@) in patients with advanced, well-differentiated GEP-NET.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This is a Phase II, open-label randomized study to assess the PK, efficacy, and safety of SYHX2008 in adult patients with well-differentiated GEP-NET. Patients will be randomized to SYHX2008 cohort or Octreotide Microspheres cohort (Sandostatin LAR@).

interventions.name: SYHX2008 injection
interventions.description: The patients will accept SYHX2008 injection by subcutaneous administration every cycle.

interventions.name: Sandostatin LAR@
interventions.description: The patients will accept Sandostatin LAR@ by intra-muscular administration every cycle.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Progression-free survival (PFS) as assessed by a Blinded Independent Review Committee (BIRC)
primaryOutcomes.description: PFS is defined as time from the date of randomization to the date of the first documented disease progression as per RECIST 1.1 or death due to any cause (whichever occurs first)
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 1 years following the last patient enrolled
